summary: Refuse suspend before any write when the declaration selects a native session; document the stop/start exit for existing holds.

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection rule change; preflight affects new suspend requests only.

schema.detail: No database schema or storage version change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules change or coordinated fleet upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: One additive non-retryable HTTP 422 code, suspend-authored-session-selection, with details.selector in REST and client-v0. Client error schema and generated Rust/Swift/TypeScript types include it; older clients use their unknown-code handling. Resume selector refusal and launch arguments retain their behavior.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption beyond ordinary daemon deployment; startup timing is not measured by this change.

manual.detail: Seats suspended by earlier builds with an authored selector remain suspended. Use st agents stop then st agents start as documented in docs/st3/suspend.md at this source revision. Stop ends the suspension; start follows the authored selector and does not guarantee the kept native session. Saved transcripts are not deleted by this exit.

recovery.detail: No data migration. Swapping back restores older suspend admission behavior and its defect; existing holds still require the documented stop/start exit when resume refuses.
